title: Device handshake
description: The four frames that turn a Path into an authenticated, encrypted session between two devices (protocol/spec/transports.md §3). They are the only plain-text frames on a Path; each is one UTF-8 JSON document. The initiator sends hello, the responder answers hello, then each sends auth. Either side may send refused instead and close.

oneOf.title: hello
oneOf.description: Who this device is and its fresh X25519 key. The transcript hashes both hellos byte for byte as sent.

eph.description: A fresh X25519 public key for this connection, base64url.

kind.description: ipad for a drawing or viewing device, link for a Link (which hosts Agents). Absent means link.

pair.description: Initiator only: the offer ID from a pairing code it scanned.

invite.description: Initiator only: the invite ID from an invite to a shared Space.

oneOf.title: auth
oneOf.description: Proof of the device key, and of the pairing or invite secret when one is used. sig = Ed25519("reflex-link/v0 auth <i|r> " || transcript); mac = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "reflex-link/v0 pair <i|r> " || transcript).

oneOf.title: refused
oneOf.description: Why a device ended the handshake. It reveals nothing secret.

device.description: A device ID: dev- and the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of its Ed25519 public key, in hex.

key.description: A raw 32-byte public key, base64url without padding.

person.description: A person by ID and display name, as devices exchange them.

sig.description: An Ed25519 signature or an HMAC-SHA256, base64url without padding.
